accepted.reason: Baylor fired Aranda this week and plays its first game under an interim coach on the road Friday night; numberFire has UCF at 61% yet the price implies 50.5%. UCF just beat No. 2 BYU and is 4-1 ATS as a dog.

accepted.matchup: New Jersey Devils @ Vegas Golden Knights
accepted.reason: Devils are on the second night of a back-to-back after Denver altitude, third game in four nights; Vegas is 9-4-1, home and rested since Tuesday. Rested-home vs road-B2B spots win ~56%+, above the 53.5% breakeven even with Hellebuyck in net.

Line moved from -4.5 to -5.5 purely on Wednesday's 129-99 blowout with Kawhi already out for both games; that is an overreaction to one result, and teams off a 30-point loss cover at a slightly better clip. Only needs 51.3% to be +EV.
